name: PointCentral
positioning: One trusted, cloud-based smart property platform for access, energy, water and video management at scale.
description: PointCentral, an Alarm.com company, is a cloud-based smart-property platform for property managers. It covers access management (smart locks), energy and water management, video surveillance and noise monitoring, and self-guided tours, managed from a single dashboard across a portfolio of units.
real_estate_use: A property manager automates move-in and move-out access on a portfolio of smart rental units through PointCentral instead of rekeying locks or coordinating in-person handoffs, and sets smart thermostats and water valves to reduce vacant-unit utility costs and leak damage. For a self-guided tour, the platform grants a verified prospect temporary digital access to a specific unit and logs the visit, and the same dashboard raises alerts from video and noise monitoring if an issue occurs after hours.

use_cases.job: Automate move-in and move-out access across a portfolio of smart rental units
Reduce vacant-unit utility costs and leak damage with remote thermostat and water-valve control
